chapter.verse: Tu-in no mihaute, na ngai dih un. Note' tunga hong tung ding lunggim sintawlnate hangin kapin mau un.
Na hauhna uh ngot khinta a, na puantualte uh nget khinta hi.

Na khamte uh leh na ngunte uh kekseu khinta hi. Tua kekseuna pen note' langkhat ah teci hiding a, tua in mei' kattum bangin na sa uh hong netum ding hi. Hunleni nunungte sungah vangil a khol na hi tazen uh hi.
En un, na lo uh a kho dinga na cialte uh khembawlin amau' thaman na piak loh teng uh tu-in note' langkhat ah hong kiko uh a, anlate' kikona Vanglian Topa' bil dong tung khinta hi.
Leitung ah nop-omna leh noptatna tawh na nungta uh a, sa kigawh ni bangin na lungsimte uh na vakthau khin uh hi.
Midikmi mawhpaihin na tualthah uh a, amah in note hong nang zolo hi.

Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, Topa' hong pai mateng lungduaitak ngak un. Guah masa leh guah nunung a zuk masiah lokhopa in lei pana hong piang ding gahleteh manphate lungduaitak a ngakna thu ngaihsun un.
Note zong na lungduai un. Topa' hong pai ding hun nai ta ahih manin na lungsim uh thahatsak un.
Sanggamte aw, Pasian' mawhpaih na thuakkhak loh nadingun khatlekhat na kiphunsan kei un. En un, kongbiang ah Thukhen Mangpa hong ding ta hi.
Sanggamte aw, gimthuakna leh lungduaina lamsang etteh lim dingin Topa' min tawh thugenkhia kamsangte ngaihsun un.
En un, a thuakzo mite thuphangah i ci hi. Job a thuakzawhna thu leh Topa' ngimna thu na za ngei khin uh a, Topa pen lainatna leh thukhualna tawh kidim cih na thei uh hi.

Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, a thupipen ah kiciam kei un. Mawhsak thukhenna na thuakkhak loh nadingun vantung tawh ahi-a leitung leh thuciamna dang khatpeuh tawh ahi zongin kiciam kei unla, ahite “Hi,” ahilote “Hilo,” ci lel un.
Note' lakah gimsiatna a thuak khatpeuh a om hiam? Thungen ta hen. A lungdam khatpeuh a om hiam? Pahtawina la sa hen.
Note' lakah cina khatpeuh a om hiam? Pawlpi makaite sam henla amaute in Topa' min tawh amah sathau nilhin thungetsak ta hen.
Tua hileh upna tawh thungetna in micina honkhia ding a, Topa in amah phongto ding hi. Mawhna bawlkhak a neih leh zong a mawhna kimaisak ding hi.
Tua ahih manin na cidam nadingun khatlekhat na mawhnate uh kipulak unla khatlekhat thu kingetsak un. Midikmi' thungetna gamtangin muibun mahmah hi.
Elijah zong eite mah bangin mihing khat mah hinapi-in guahzuk loh nading thungetna nakpi-in a neih ciangin leitung ah kum thum leh kha guk sung guahzu lo hi.
Tua ciangin thungen leuleu a, vantung in guahtui pia-in leitung in gahleteh hong nei hi.
Ka sanggamte aw, note' lakah thumaan thutak pan a pialkhia khat om henla tua panin hong tunpihkik khatpeuh a om leh
amah in hih thu thei ta hen. Mawhnei khat a pialkhiatna pan lampi maan a tunpihkik peuhpeuh pen mawhneipa' nunna kha, sihna pan a honkhia hi a, mawhna lompi khat a seelsak ahi hi.
